observation.visible_scene: A heavily out-of-focus (defocused) macro view against a near-black background. A horizontal band of bright, shimmering specular highlights runs across the upper third of the frame, with a few rounded/loop-like bright blobs embedded in it, and scattered small bright bokeh dots float in the darker lower region.
visible_changes: The bright horizontal band continuously undulates vertically (rising and falling a few percent of frame height) and changes width and shape from frame to frame.
Within the band, ring/loop-like bright blobs appear, merge and re-form (e.g. frames 1, 7, 11, 25, 32, 36), i.e. local deformation rather than a single object sliding across.
The overall brightness and contrast of the band flicker between frames.
The scattered bright dots in the lower dark area drift and change intensity independently of the band.
No discrete object enters, exits, or completes a motion; the band and dots remain present throughout the excerpt, only shimmering and reconfiguring.
outside_clip_unknowns: What the bright band actually is (a liquid surface, a string of bubbles, a textured/glass edge, or an out-of-focus light source) is not identifiable.
The lighting setup and focus plane are unseen.
Whether any motion is camera motion or subject motion cannot be separated because there is no sharp background reference.
The state of the scene before t=0 and after t=2.67s is unknown.
uncertain_details: Camera movement vs. object movement is indistinguishable due to the strong defocus.
The bright dots may be suspended particles, reflections, or pure bokeh of distant lights; identity uncertain.
The band may be one continuous structure or several overlapping bright regions; the blur prevents a firm distinction.
The exact vertical position of the band at each frame is approximate because edges are soft.
